name: openbb_economy_calendar
description:
Economic events calendar (releases with actual, consensus and previous values) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.calendar).
Returns: {tool, provider, start_date, end_date, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, note when the window has no events, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): start_date and end_date (default: the past 7 days to the next 7); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp, fred, nasdaq, tradingeconomics; default nasdaq).
Another source: fmp_economic_calendar; company earnings dates: openbb_equity_calendar_earnings. Keys: nasdaq needs none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; fred uses SAJHA's FRED_API_KEY; tradingeconomics needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"start_date": "2026-10-05", "end_date": "2026-10-09"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows

note.description: Set when the window has no events
